scope: Read-only investigation of authorized DraftKings Predictions Sports/NFL access; not DraftKings Sportsbook.
zeroCountMeaning: No exact live DraftKings contract/quote/rules combination was verified through accessible authorized responses. This does not establish that DraftKings has no NFL markets.

publicDraftKingsInspection.inspectionMethod: Offline decoding of the React Router loader-data array already included in the observed public HTML. No secondary application data endpoint was requested.
publicDraftKingsInspection.embeddedIdentifiers: Some event/selection IDs occur in CMS navigation and template-query configuration. They are not complete verified live contract records and were not treated as discoveries.
publicDraftKingsInspection.noMarketsTextCaveat: Localized no-markets strings occur in the translation catalogue. Their presence is not evidence that the actual NFL inventory is empty.
publicDraftKingsInspection.conclusion: Public route and NFL navigation are accessible; exact current NFL contract quotes and settlement mappings were not verified from this response.

vendors.name: OpticOdds
vendors.classification: Explicit DraftKings Predictions vendor candidate; credentials and entitlement required; live DK responses not verified.

verifiedDocumentation.supportedPriceFormat: PROBABILITY is documented; defaults differ between endpoint/guide examples, so must request the format explicitly.
verifiedDocumentation.fees: Guide states that returned odds include fee adjustments by default; exclude_fees=true requests raw exchange prices.

vendors.nextVerification: With an authorized entitled key, query the venue catalogue, discover active NFL fixtures, fetch their odds with explicit venue/format/fee settings, then validate native IDs and exact contract terms before publication. A normalized line or implied probability alone is insufficient.

error.message: Request is missing API key. Supply X-API-KEY.

vendors.nextVerification: Obtain authorized scoped evaluation access and require a real exact-contract sample. Do not substitute ordinary DraftKings sportsbook rows or reconstruct exact prices by rounding normalized odds.

vendors.name: Crawlora
vendors.classification: Reference/navigation API; not a live contract-price feed.
vendors.verifiedDocumentation: Its three documented endpoints cover category navigation, availability regions and rule-source links; the documentation explicitly excludes market quotes and trades.

vendors.name: Crypto.com / CDNA official market-data API
vendors.classification: An underlying exchange data surface was reachable, but it is not a verified DraftKings retail feed and is not licensed for this application by anonymous access.
vendors.licenseBoundary: The public documentation advertises anonymous personal/noncommercial read access, but requires MDLA for redistribution/commercial use/training. The linked EULA additionally restricts AI processing and derived/public redistribution absent consent. No claim is made that anonymous access licenses GRIDIRON AI use.
notVerified: Exact identity with DraftKings retail offerings
Approved right to ingest into an AI research app

vendors.name: DKeX / Railbird direct
vendors.classification: Official exchange/onboarding route; no authorized live API session or public exact retail feed verified.
verifiedDocumentation: Official exchange contact page lists onboarding and FIX-connectivity contacts.
vendors.limitation: An exchange rulebook or delayed daily exchange report does not establish current retail DraftKings executable quotes or account fees. No membership request or contact was sent.

recommendedPath: Use an explicitly authorized DraftKings Predictions-entitled vendor evaluation key, preferably a candidate whose source_ids/order-book schema can preserve native identities. Require real NFL samples and exact settlement/fee metadata before enabling live comparisons. Keep verified manual capture optional and visibly manual. No silent exchange or sportsbook alias.
manualFallback: Preserve the existing optional user-verified contract/screenshot/CSV capture. Require exact platform, event/contract ID, player/team, threshold/operator, Yes/No side, quote timestamp, source, fees and settlement terms; missing facts remain unavailable. A manual capture is never labeled a live feed.

finalAccessibleLiveDraftKingsMarkets.reason: No authorized live DraftKings contract response could be obtained with current access; vendor probes returned credential errors and public site inspection supplied navigation only.
